name: Wiki and skill facts
ownerWords: knowledge manager (make llm-wiki info and, skills always up to date)
goal: Every curated wiki page (apps/, domains/) and every repo skill (.agents/skills, .claude/rules/app-*.md) names only code facts that still hold: no repo path, file::name, env or constant name, pnpm script or script flag it cites was taken away by an auto-sns-agent commit after the page's updated date or the skill's last commit. The target is 0 because the owner asked for them 'always up to date'. Missing page paths under apps, convex, packages, scripts and ops stay with the Wiki dream duty. The first run on 2026-11-20 took 179 s on us-metal02 under load, so the soft target is 600 s.

metrics.label: Wiki pages and skills that name a code fact a later commit took away

Skills that name a code fact a later commit took away

onMiss: Fix every flagged page and skill this run, one subagent per page or skill, until docs_with_stale_facts is 0. Each subagent reads the flagged facts, finds the commit that took each one away in ~/Documents/Github/auto-sns-agent, reads the code at HEAD and rewrites the doc so every fact it states is true now. A page changes only through the wiki page API (the sieun-pi wiki module, wiki.write), with its updated date bumped. A skill or app rule changes by a commit with `node scripts/repo/agent/commit.mjs -m "docs(skills): ..." <files>` from that checkout, read first with `node scripts/skills/read-skill.mjs <skill>`; never push dev/sieun. Then rerun the precheck (scripts/duties/wiki-skill-facts.ts in sieun-pi legacy/prime/user-history) and go again. A false count, such as a fact the doc names as history or a vendor's setting, gets a fix in wiki-skill-facts.ts with a case in test/duty-wiki-skill-facts.test.ts. Report the count before and after with the pages and commits; a quiet day sends nothing.
